calibration.fallback_policy: missing strata are a verifier/configuration error; simulator may use only explicitly aggregated empirical type/default ranges
calibration.method: empirical robust summaries from frozen response log; no unmarked constants

phase_definitions.release_with_transport: transport_dttm to available_dttm, including transport-to-hospital and handoff while the unit remains occupied
phase_definitions.release_without_transport: zero because the complete busy interval is already represented as service

clock.timezone: America/Los_Angeles (source wall-clock; simulator uses naive logical seconds)

counterfactual: agent actions and resulting transitions, hidden future event observations, deterministic event replay under alternate dispatches
derived: normalized priority, dispatchable filter, ALS requirement policy, 7-day roster, initial busy/free status, coarse unit zone, empirical calibration summaries
observed: incident arrival time, call type, raw priority, coarse battalion/station zone, source row IDs
historical response phase timestamps used only for calibration/reference replay

roster.selection: sha256(seed:unit_id), quotas MEDIC=8 BLS=2 PRIVATE=2 then deterministic fill
